why: a rule binds to a role and the role comes from the path, so an unmapped file escapes every rule
fix: move the file under a role path or ask the operator to extend gates/roles.json
agents_md: Every source file has a role from gates/roles.json.

why: the controls protect themselves; an agent must not weaken the gates it is judged by
fix: restore the control file and deliver the change as a patch for the operator
agents_md: Never edit operator-only files.

why: force pushes, skipped hooks and mutating API calls bypass review
fix: use the allowed alternative named in the message
agents_md: Never force-push, skip hooks or call gh api with a mutating method.

why: a secret in a file ends up in git history
fix: read the value from the environment or a secret store

why: prose and gates drift apart unless every rule line names its gate
fix: end the rule line with (gate: ID) or (review); the operator edits AGENTS.md
agents_md: Keep AGENTS.md under 100 lines with a gate id or (review) on every rule line.

why: decisions are found by make adr-find only when every record has the same shape
fix: use make adr-new, keep frontmatter id, title, status, tags, stay under 50 lines, run make decisions
agents_md: One ADR per decision; ask before writing one.

why: an inline suppression turns a gate green without fixing the finding
fix: fix the finding; only the operator raises gates/suppress-baseline.json
agents_md: Never weaken, suppress or bypass a gate.

why: a core returns rejections as values so every caller decides
fix: return a { kind: "rejected", reason } value
agents_md: Never throw in a core; return the rejection as a value.

why: only an adapter knows how its foreign system fails
fix: let the adapter return a value for the failure and switch on that value
agents_md: try/catch only in adapters.

why: a core decides the same way for the same input, so tests and golden files are stable
fix: pass the time, ids or settings in as arguments from the flow
agents_md: A core reads no clock, randomness, process or console.

why: a core stays testable without starting anything
fix: pass data in from the flow; a core imports only other core modules
agents_md: A core imports only other core modules.

why: IO lives in one adapter per foreign system so it can be faked and allow-listed
fix: add or extend an adapter (server src/adapters/, web src/lib/api.ts) and pass it in
agents_md: File system, process, network and fetch only in adapters.

why: a flow sequences load, decide and apply; decisions live in the core where they are tested
fix: move the comparison into a decide* function in core and switch on its result kind
agents_md: A flow never compares or branches; it switches on a decide result.

why: any switches the type checker off
fix: name the real type, unknown plus a type guard, or a union
agents_md: any is forbidden.

why: output goes through the structured JSON logger
fix: log one JSON event with status and duration_ms through the logger port
agents_md: Log through the logger port, never console.

why: imported PDFs, transcripts and model output are untrusted; HTML strings open XSS
fix: build nodes with createElement and textContent
agents_md: Never inject HTML strings into the DOM.

why: the one-sentence doc comment is the contract a reader and a reviewing agent check the code against
fix: add /** one sentence that says what it returns or does */ above the export
agents_md: Every exported function has a one-sentence JSDoc line.

why: a blanket suppression turns a gate green without a fix
fix: fix the finding; a targeted `// eslint-disable-next-line <rule>` counts against gates/suppress-baseline.json, which only the operator raises
agents_md: No blanket eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, prettier-ignore or ast-grep-ignore.

why: a skipped, focused or todo test is green without running
fix: make the test pass or delete it in a reviewed change
agents_md: Never skip, focus or todo a test.

why: comments drift from code; facts the code cannot show are the exception
fix: delete the comment, write one `// constraint: <fact>` line, or a /** JSDoc */ on an export
agents_md: Comments only as `// constraint:`, JSDoc on exports, or tool directives.

why: long functions hide decisions
fix: split the function along its decisions
agents_md: Functions stay within the role budget in gates/roles.json.

why: long modules mix topics
fix: split the module by topic
agents_md: Modules stay within the role budget in gates/roles.json.

why: a server feature is found in one place with a fixed set of files
fix: use only api.ts and flow.ts in a server feature; decisions go to packages/core
agents_md: A server feature holds only api.ts and flow.ts.

why: a feature is only proven through its observable behaviour
fix: add packages/server/test/<feature>.behaviour.test.ts with one asserting test
agents_md: One behaviour test per server feature.

why: every decision is proven by a test that checks its result
fix: assert on the result of the decide* call in a test, directly or through a variable
agents_md: The result of every decide* flows into an expect.

why: every adapter translation of a foreign answer is proven by a test
fix: assert on the result of the translate* call in a test
agents_md: The result of every adapter translate* flows into an expect.

why: features stay separable; facts travel through the database
fix: hand the fact over through the database or a core function
agents_md: Never import one server feature from another.

why: an adapter talks to one foreign system and knows no feature
fix: move the feature logic into the flow; the adapter returns plain values
agents_md: An adapter never imports a feature.

why: a gate may only grow; changing or deleting one weakens it
fix: add a new rule with test, fixture and catalog entry instead of changing an existing one
agents_md: You may add a gate; never change or delete one.

why: markdown files of agents spread through the repository unless every new one has a fixed place
fix: put the text into an existing file or an allowed place (decisions/NNNN-*.md via make adr-new, docs/release/<version>.md, docs/review/lenses/, docs/product/, packages/<name>/README.md) or into the issue or PR
agents_md: New markdown files only in the places DOCS-PLACES lists.
